description: Move to the next workspace when the active workspace is NOT the last one on the focused monitor. The relevant monitor exposes the sorted list of workspace ids that live on it; when at least one of those ids is greater than the active id, the operation selects the immediately following id from the monitor's own list. Workspace ids that belong to other monitors and happen to fall numerically between the active id and the next monitor id are irrelevant and are skipped, because navigation stays within the focused monitor's own ordered set of workspaces. The direction selector requests the next workspace (not the previous one).
